messages:
maria: Anyone see this? Since the metadata refresh last night we've seen ~120 orphaned service accounts flagged by the audit pipeline. SCIM deprovision requests are returning 404s at the IdP and provisioning-worker logs show KMS decrypt failures.

alex: Looking now — what do you mean by 'KMS decrypt failures'? Can you paste the log snippet?

maria: ```
provisioning-worker ERROR: decrypt failed: KMS InvalidCiphertextException - keyAlias "alias/provisioning"
trace_id=abc123 svc=provisioner
```

sam: We did a scheduled rekey for alias/provisioning ~2026-03-20 22:45 UTC. Did the IdP also get a metadata update? @alex any overlap?

alex: Yes, the IdP pushed a metadata refresh and changed SAML NameIDFormat from urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:1.1:nameid-format:emailAddress to urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:2.0:nameid-format:persistent. That will change the subject value we hash into external_id.

maria: :facepalm: That explains the 404s — deprov looks up external_id -> SCIM record. If NameID changes, the external_id won't match existing entries so the deprov requests fail and accounts are left orphaned.

maria: The KMS decrypt errors suggest the provisioner is trying to decrypt tokens encrypted with the prior key; if the rekey didn't publish a decrypt facade for the old envelope key, decrypts will fail.

ops-bot: alert: scim-deprov-failure-rate > 10% (3m) — grouping by error=404,decrypt_error

sam: Immediate mitigations: 1) Pause the automated SCIM deprovision job (it keeps re-queuing failures). 2) Ask KMS team to enable the previous key ring for decrypt or provide transient re-encrypt facade. 3) Backfill an old->new NameID mapping and re-run deprov for affected accounts.

alex: I can backfill mapping if we have SAML assertion logs that include old and new NameID values. I'll run a logs query: `resource.type=identity_provider AND proto.saml.nameid_old:*` and export mappings.

maria: I'll open an incident (INC-2026-032) and attach an immediate runbook: pause deprov, request KMS facade, run mapping backfill, then reconcile orphaned svcaccs. For longer term: update provisioner to accept a fallback external_id namespace for N days after a NameIDFormat change and emit a metric `scim.nameid_changes`.

sam: :thumbsup: I'll coordinate with KMS. If the decrypt facade doesn't work we'll need emergency key import/rollback which is more involved. Keep me cc'd on INC.

alex: Note: some svcaccs use legacy manually-set external IDs (svcacc-legacy-*) — those must be excluded from bulk deprovs or we'll break customer dashboards.

maria: Good catch. I'll add exclusion patterns to the runbook. Thanks all — will post status updates in the incident thread and a short postmortem once we stabilize. Pinging @security-leads for visibility.
